operations.name: serversShow
operations.description: Returns detailed information about a specific TeamSpeak virtual server.

operations.name: serversBans
operations.description: Returns a list of all bans on the TeamSpeak server.

operations.name: serversChannels
operations.description: Returns the channel tree with nested sub-channels for a running server.

operations.name: serversClients
operations.description: Returns a list of all connected clients on a running TeamSpeak server.

operations.name: serversComplaints
operations.description: Returns a list of all complaints on the TeamSpeak server.

operations.name: serversStats
operations.description: Returns connection statistics and live data for a running server.

operations.name: serversStatsHistory
operations.description: Returns historical server statistics for a given time period.

operations.name: serversTokens
operations.description: Returns a list of all privilege keys (tokens) and server groups.

operations.name: serversBansClear
operations.description: Removes all bans from the TeamSpeak server.
operations.label: Sperrliste leeren

operations.name: serversBansCreate
operations.description: Creates a new ban rule on the TeamSpeak server. At least one of ip, name, or uid must be provided.

duration.description: Ban duration in seconds (0 or null = permanent)

operations.label: Sperre erstellen

operations.name: serversChannelsCreate
operations.description: Creates a new channel on the TeamSpeak server.

codec.description: Audio codec (0=Speex Narrowband, 1=Speex Wideband, 2=Speex Ultra-Wideband, 3=CELT Mono, 4=Opus Voice, 5=Opus Music)

operations.label: Kanal erstellen

operations.name: serversClientsKick
operations.description: Kicks a connected client from the server or channel.
operations.label: Client entfernen

operations.name: serversClientsMove
operations.description: Moves a connected client to a different channel.
operations.label: Client verschieben

operations.name: serversClientsPoke
operations.description: Sends a poke message to a connected client.
operations.label: Client anstupsen

operations.name: serversSettingsUpdate
operations.description: Updates server properties like name, welcome message, and host banner.

welcome_message.description: Welcome message shown on connect (max 1024 characters)

hostbanner_url.description: URL opened when clicking the host banner

hostbanner_gfx_url.description: URL of the host banner image

operations.label: Server-Einstellungen

operations.name: serversStart
operations.description: Starts a stopped TeamSpeak virtual server.
operations.label: Starten

operations.name: serversStop
operations.description: Stops a running TeamSpeak virtual server.
operations.label: Stoppen

operations.name: serversTsdnsUpdate
operations.description: Sets or updates the TSDNS hostname for a TeamSpeak server.
operations.label: TS-DNS bearbeiten

operations.name: serversTsdnsRemove
operations.description: Removes the TSDNS hostname from a TeamSpeak server.
operations.label: TS-DNS entfernen

operations.name: get
operations.description: Returns the authenticated reseller account details including company information, contact details, tax information, enabled products, and credit balance.

operations.name: update
operations.description: Updates non-critical account fields such as company name, contact name, phone, and address. Email, tax ID, and status cannot be changed via API.
